review.note: WR 0% over 6 TP+SL, avg_r -0.75: no TP1 hit at all, so not a low-WR/high-RR case. 14.10 short was right in direction but stopped by the CPI spike inside the blackout. 15.10 am: first non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - price reached TP1 1.41961 without touching entry 1.42290; entry 14 pips above price was too deep for a 5-pip pullback. 15.10 pm: second straight non-fill (DEEP_ENTRY) - stopped 3.0 pips short, the blackout touch at 14:35 would have paid TP1 +1.79R; 2 of the last 2 orders missed by entries set at the sweep level instead of the zone near edge. 16.10 am: third straight non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - entry 16.8 pips above price at H1 LH 1.42020, real pullback only 1.6 pips (cap = London high 1.41868 / H1 OB wick), TP1/TP2 then traded. 3 of the last 3 orders missed with entries 15-17 pips from price, while the moves themselves would have paid. 20.10 pm: fourth straight non-fill (NO_PULLBACK) - TP1 traded 10 minutes after creation, entry 26 pips away never approached closer than 14.3 pips. 21.10 pm: the one shallow entry that DID fill (OB 11:00, no sweep before it, RR 1.14) was run over by an H1 body close 18 pips through the zone - ZONE_FAILED #4; shallow fills on unswept OBs fail, deep entries don't fill. 22.10 am: INVALIDATED (NO_PULLBACK) - TP2 traded 09:05 before fill, entry touched only 13:05 after the cancel; 5 of the last 7 orders never filled in time. 22.10 pm: EXPIRED (DEEP_ENTRY) - pullback stopped 6.9 pips short at the zone NEAR edge 1.40386 (56% of path), TP1 traded 18:50; 6 of the last 8 orders never filled, and in 3 of them the zone near edge would have filled and paid TP1. 23.10 am: FIRST TP - SELL 1.40180 at the H1 FVG near-ish edge (FVG 1.40154-1.40205, entry 2.6 pips inside), filled 08:50 on the Judas sweep of EQH 1.40151/1.40161 (high 1.40195), TP1 Asia low 1.39975 taken 13:25: +1.64R / +20.5 pips. The winning combination: FVG basis, with H4/H1/D1 trend, sweep of an EQH pool into the zone, entry inside the zone not at its far edge.
review.proposal: Entry at the zone NEAR edge of an untouched FVG after a liquidity sweep into it (23.10 am pattern), max 8 pips from price at creation; drop OB-basis entries without a prior sweep (0 TP / 5 SL); SL beyond the zone far edge + 10 pips.
